full_prompt_en: A detailed, painterly illustration presents a compact island settlement and its near-mirrored reflection in still blue water. Closely packed buildings rise into a tall irregular cluster at the centre of the square frame. Weathered façades in brick red, ochre yellow, cream, muted blue, and gray overlap at different heights. Repeated small windows, projecting balconies, railings, roof edges, and patches of greenery make the settlement intricate without obscuring its overall silhouette. A yellow multi-storey building stands high toward the left, with a red structure rising behind it. On the right, a narrow dark tree and lower buildings balance the taller mass. Slim poles and open scaffold-like frameworks interrupt the skyline. The settlement rests on a thin strip of grassy, uneven ground that meets the water across the middle of the composition. A small yellow vehicle appears along the right-hand shore. The island edge is dark and irregular, with vegetation trailing close to the water. Below that edge, the buildings and trees appear upside down as a single continuous reflection, their colors slightly subdued and their details softened. The reflected cluster tapers downward, repeating the upper silhouette rather than forming a separate hanging town. Large cream-white clouds gather on either side against a muted blue sky and reappear in the water. Soft daylight distinguishes sunlit walls from shaded recesses. Fine surface marks lend the architecture an aged, hand-painted character. Warm façades stand against cool open space, and the central reflection gives the densely constructed fantasy a quiet, balanced atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅细节丰富、带绘画质感的插画，紧凑的小岛聚落与近乎镜像的倒影共同呈现在平静蓝色水面上。建筑在方形画面中央紧密叠起，组成高耸而不规则的群体。砖红、赭黄、奶油白、灰蓝和灰色的风化立面以不同高度相互遮叠。密集小窗、外挑阳台、栏杆、屋檐和零星绿植使聚落细致繁复，但整体轮廓依然清楚。左上方立着较高的黄色多层楼，后面又升起红色建筑；右侧细长深色树木和较矮房屋平衡高处体量。纤细杆件与通透脚手架般的结构穿插在天际线中。聚落坐落于狭窄、起伏而覆草的地面上，沿画面中部接触水面，右侧岸边有一辆很小的黄色车。岛缘深暗而不规则，植被贴近水面下垂。岸缘以下，建筑与树木作为连续倒影上下颠倒，色彩稍收敛，细节略柔化。倒影向下收窄，重复上方轮廓，并非另一个倒挂的实体城镇。大团奶油白云分列聚落两侧，衬着低饱和蓝天，又映入水中。柔和日光区分受光墙面与阴暗凹处，细密表面痕迹赋予建筑古旧的手绘质感。暖色立面与冷色开阔空间相对，中央倒影使繁复构筑的幻想景象保持安静平衡。
style_prompt_en: Detailed painterly illustration combines fine linear accents, weathered surface marks, and softly modeled color. Ochre, brick red, cream, and muted blue form compact layered masses against broader cool fields. Small repeated shapes establish density while irregular edges prevent a mechanically uniform finish. Gentle daylight separates warm illuminated planes from cool recesses. A clear horizontal axis supports a softened reflected echo, with subdued color and slightly reduced detail below it. The composition balances a concentrated, vertically layered focal mass with open space on either side. Soft pale highlights and restrained surface grain give the richly constructed image an airy, quietly surreal character.
style_prompt_zh: 细致绘画插画结合纤细线条、风化表面痕迹和柔和塑形色彩。赭黄、砖红、奶油白与灰蓝组成紧凑层叠的体块，衬在更宽阔的冷色域前。重复小形状建立密度，不规则边缘避免机械整齐。柔和日光区分暖色受光面与冷色凹处。清晰水平轴线承接柔化镜像，下方颜色更收敛、细节略减少。构图以集中且纵向叠起的视觉重心平衡两侧留白，柔软浅色亮部和克制表面颗粒让繁复形象带有通透、安静的超现实感。
theme_en: A compact island town of colorful stacked houses reflected in still water
theme_zh: 彩色房屋层叠的小岛聚落映在静水中
name: Tilted view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
